narrative: OMX30 opens Friday in a strong bull market setup with price +10.2% above the 200-MA and trading at 52-week highs. ADX 79.6 confirms trend strength, while MACD remains bullish above signal. However, RSI 84.14 and Stochastic K=88.6 flash severe overbought conditions—a classic mean reversion setup. Commodity tailwinds (gold +2.57%, copper +0.84%) support Boliden and industrial complexes, while USD/SEK at 9.506 favours Swedish exporters. The core risk is profit-taking into resistance; any pullback should find support at 3085 (lower Bollinger). Global correlation signal neutral; US equities mixed and European peers lukewarm suggest caution at extremes.
morningBrief: OMX30 poised to open higher on continued bull momentum, but technicals are stretched. RSI 84.14 and Stochastic K=88.6 are in the red zone—expect intraday volatility and possible pullback. Key levels: 3123 (Friday pivot), 3180 (50-MA resistance), 3085 (lower Bollinger support). Exporters should bid on USD/SEK strength; watch Volvo B, Atlas Copco A, and Ericsson B if tech sentiment steadies. Boliden a tactical long on gold/copper strength. Banks (SEB A, Handelsbanken A) supported by US 10Y at 4.67%, but avoid chasing at highs—mean reversion risk elevated. Oil +1.42% creates modest headwind for consumer discretionary; H&M B faces dual pressure (weak EUR/SEK + oil). US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) key trigger for late-session direction.
